title: COC Compliant Electric Fence Installation
subtitle: High-voltage perimeter electric fencing with energizer and alarm monitoring

problemHeadline: Low or sagging perimeter walls invite opportunistic trespassing and burglary
problemBody: Non-compliant electric fences with low voltage or loose wire tension fail to deter intruders.

escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after COC delivery and high-voltage trip test.

articleSections.heading: SANS 10222-3 Safety Standard
articleSections.body: Fences are installed with mandated warning signs, earthing spikes, and legal wire spacing.

articleSections.heading: High-Voltage Pulse Test
articleSections.body: Energizers deliver a legal 9,000V shock that deters intruders while triggering alarms on wire cuts.
